title: Community Forum Safety Enforcement
business: A regional hobbyist forum platform that hosts user-generated discussion threads.
problem: The platform faces high operational costs and inconsistent enforcement when human moderators manually review thousands of daily posts for harassment or hate speech.
solution: The platform integrates the text-moderation-latest model via the /v1/moderations endpoint to automatically flag incoming user posts against safety categories before they are published to the public feed.
steps: Configure the application backend to intercept new post submissions before database persistence.
Send the raw text content of the post to the /v1/moderations endpoint.
Parse the JSON response to check the boolean flags for categories like hate, harassment, or self-harm.
Route posts flagged as true to a human review queue and allow non-flagged posts to proceed to the public feed.
outcome: The platform achieves a consistent baseline for content safety, significantly reducing the volume of benign content that human moderators must manually inspect.
limitation: The model is a text-only moderation tool, meaning it cannot analyze images or embedded media attached to posts; developers must implement separate validation logic for non-text content.
